intro.fr: Untitled Goose Game se joue en multiworld Archipelago grâce à un APWorld communautaire, distribué hors de l'installation officielle.
intro.en: Untitled Goose Game can be played in an Archipelago multiworld through a community APWorld, distributed outside the official install.

text.fr: Création du dépôt GitHub PixelShake92/Untitled-Goose-Game-Archipelago, qui héberge l'APWorld de Untitled Goose Game.
text.en: The GitHub repository PixelShake92/Untitled-Goose-Game-Archipelago, home of the Untitled Goose Game APWorld, is created.

text.fr: Publication de la première version, Alpha Version 1.0.
text.en: The first version, Alpha Version 1.0, is released.

text.fr: Publication de la version Alpha_2.2.1, la plus récente au 21 octobre 2026 (6 versions publiées).
text.en: Version Alpha_2.2.1 is released, the latest as of October 21, 2026 (6 versions released).

text.fr: Untitled Goose Game figure dans le tableur communautaire des APWorlds, qui recense les mondes jouables hors de l'installation officielle d'Archipelago.
text.en: Untitled Goose Game is listed in the community APWorlds spreadsheet, which tracks the worlds playable outside the official Archipelago install.
